'''2022 MPC Steve Baroni LS TIGIH''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TIGIH Baroni LS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
